# rustinion_log_metric_definition (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion "logs to metrics" definition: a regex pattern evaluated against every ingested log line, turning a match into a custom-metric sample. Tenant-wide (no group_id) — bounded at 20 definitions per tenant server-side.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `extraction` (String) One of: "count" (every matching line produces a sample of 1) or "capture_group" (the pattern's own first capturing group is parsed as the sample's numeric value).
- `name` (String) Unique within the tenant; also the resulting custom-metric's own name.
- `pattern` (String) A regex evaluated against every ingested log line's message. For extraction = "capture_group", must have at least one real capturing group.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
